lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple vertical columns of high-intensity, roughly circular white pixel clusters arranged in 4-5 horizontal tiers posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal rows of high-intensity blobs, forming a discernible grid-like matrix across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature characterized by a sharp luminance gradient (lighter above, darker shadow below) running across the upper third of the visible flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low to moderate density of small, high-luminance blobs visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily concentrated along the lower anterior half.
